author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Ethos anthropoi daimon (Ἦθος ἀνθρώπῳ δαίμων) — Heraclitus Fragment 119
explanation: You do not need an astrologer, a fortune teller, or an oracle to forecast your future. Look at your daily habits: your discipline, your honesty, your temper, and your loyalty. These daily moral choices are the architects quietly constructing your fate.
practicalInsight: Make one honorable, courageous choice today that aligns with the highest version of who you aspire to be.
reflectionPrompt: If your daily habits and private character are writing your destiny, what kind of future are you currently authoring?
